text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank retains documents only as long as legally required or business-justified, then destroys them securely.**  
---
name: Chunk 5/24

raw_entities.name: Document Retention and Destruction Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's policy governing the retention and secure destruction of documents. The policy establishes that documents are retained only as long as legally required or business-justified, after which they must be destroyed securely. This policy addresses compliance obligations and operational risk management related to document lifecycle management.
context: FirstUK Bank retains documents only as long as legally required or business-justified, then destroys them securely.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Document Retention Duration Limitation
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring that documents be retained only for the duration that is legally required or business-justified. This establishes the upper bound on retention periods and prevents indefinite storage of documents.
context: FirstUK Bank retains documents only as long as legally required or business-justified

raw_entities.name: Secure Document Destruction Requirement
raw_entities.description: Provision mandating that documents must be destroyed securely once retention periods expire. This requirement ensures that sensitive information is not left vulnerable to unauthorized access or recovery after its business or legal purpose has ended.

raw_entities.name: Data Breach Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that retained documents containing sensitive information may be accessed, disclosed, or recovered by unauthorized parties. This risk is mitigated through secure destruction practices once documents are no longer required.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that FirstUK Bank may fail to meet legal retention requirements or retain documents beyond legally mandated periods, resulting in regulatory violations or enforcement action.
context: retains documents only as long as legally required

raw_entities.name: Secure Document Destruction Process
raw_entities.description: The operational safeguard requiring secure destruction of documents once retention periods expire. This control measure implements the policy's mandate to prevent unauthorized access to or recovery of sensitive information.
